name: Minagawa Yuuhi
source:
Yuuhi is Tomoki’s childhood friend who lives above the cafe that her father owns, she also works part-time in the cafe. She gets on well with everyone, although she is a little apprehensive of [url=/c2280]Yua[/url] at first. She is also quite tsun towards Tomoki but she secretly has feelings for him. Yuuhi is quite a good cook and is also in the same class as Tomoki.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/14/your-diary-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
